problem_severity.evidence: Homeowners waste $200-500/year on energy; active Reddit discussions show frustration with $300-500 audit costs

demand_signals.evidence: signals.md: 22K monthly searches for 'home energy audit'; 4.2M member r/homeimprovement community actively discussing; +25-45% YoY growth on key terms; library energy-lending waitlists (Arlington's first 4 loaner cameras drew an 8-month waitlist) show borrow demand for clip-on thermal cameras

competitive_intensity.evidence: competitors.csv / gtm_plan.md: HomeBoost BoostBox ($99 DIY kit with a thermal camera that plugs into an iPhone, launched Oct 2024) is a direct competitor with a head start; FLIR's own app and FLIR-approved home-energy apps (Home Boost, HouseRater); Seek (Nano has no third-party SDK, only Seek's own app); professional auditors expensive ($300-500)

market_size.evidence: market_size.md: TAM $4.5B home energy management; SAM narrows to about $236M (estimate) because activation needs a clip-on thermal camera the homeowner owns, buys or borrows; 15% CAGR

execution_difficulty.evidence: mvp_spec.md / risks.md: the free FLIR Mobile SDK gives real radiometric (per-pixel temperature) data, removing the sensor-feasibility risk; AI labelling of thermal images is custom-built core IP and needs ML model training; FLIR's pre-release app approval is a gate; the app must support iOS and Android; contractor marketplace is complex

gtm_viability.evidence: gtm_plan.md: clear channels: SEO/content ($8-12 CAC), YouTube, App Store, plus library energy-lending programs; ICP actively searching; r/homeimprovement is accessible; but owning or borrowing a camera gates activation

timing.evidence: market_size.md: sub-$200 FLIR ONE Gen 3 ($199.99 list, $149.99 on sale Nov-Dec 2024) and a FLIR ONE for USB-C iPhones (Dec 2024); library lending programs; energy costs at multi-year highs; DIY trend continues post-pandemic; risks.md: but HomeBoost moved first (Oct 2024)

recommendation.rationale: A borderline GO: the composite of 65 sits exactly on the GO threshold, carried by solid demand signals, accessible GTM channels and a FLIR Mobile SDK that removes the sensor-feasibility risk. The deciding factors are HomeBoost's head start with its $99 BoostBox kit and whether enough homeowners can own, buy or borrow a supported FLIR ONE camera.

Create landing page to test pricing and waitlist interest
Begin content creation for SEO foundation, and contact library lending programs about partnerships
